create_impala_actor: create an IMPALAActor instance with a Sonnet RNNCore network and optional adder and variable client
select_action_impala: select an action from the IMPALAActor policy by passing an observation and sampling from categorical logits
observe_first_impala: call observe_first on IMPALAActor to add the initial timestep to the replay buffer and reset RNN state
observe_impala: call observe on IMPALAActor to log an action and next timestep with logits and core state extras
update_impala_variables: call update on IMPALAActor to synchronize variables from the variable client with optional wait flag
